blocks.prompt: 14 A force \(\underline{F} = (20, -10, 30)\) N is applied at a point \(P(2, -1, 4)\) in 3D space. The pivot point is at \(M(1, 2, -3)\). Calculate the torque produced by this force about the pivot point \(M\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi torque ka sawal hai, lekin is dafa pivot origin par nahi, point \(M\) par hai.
Diya kya hai? Force \(\underline{F}\), woh point \(P\) jahan force lagi, aur pivot \(M\).
Find kya karna hai? \(M\) ke gird torque.
Rule kaunsa? \(\underline{\tau} = \underline{r} \times \underline{F}\), jahan \(\underline{r}\) pivot \(M\) se \(P\) tak.
Plan: pehle \(\underline{r} = \overrightarrow{MP}\), phir determinant se cross product.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{F} = 20\underline{i} - 10\underline{j} + 30\underline{k}\) N, point \(P(2, -1, 4)\) par; pivot \(M(1, 2, -3)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(M\) ke gird torque \(\underline{\tau}\).
Tareeqa: \(\underline{\tau} = \underline{r} \times \underline{F}\), \(\underline{r} = \overrightarrow{MP}\). Kyun \(\overrightarrow{MP}\), \(\overrightarrow{OP}\) nahi? Torque hamesha us point ke gird napa jata hai jahan cheez ghoomti hai; \(\underline{r}\) usi pivot se shuru hona chahiye.

\(\underline{r}\) nikalein
\[\underline{r} = \overrightarrow{MP} = (2 - 1)\underline{i} + (-1 - 2)\underline{j} + (4 + 3)\underline{k}\]
\[= \underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + 7\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{r}\) pivot \(M\) se shuru ho kar \(P\) par khatam hota hai, to "aakhri minus pehla" \(= P - M\). \(4 - (-3) = 7\).
Dhyan dein: \(M - P\) lena aam ghalti hai; us se torque ka sign poora ulta aa jata hai.

Cross product
\[\underline{\tau} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 1 & -3 & 7 \\ 20 & -10 & 30 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (-90 + 70)\underline{i} - (30 - 140)\underline{j} + (-10 + 60)\underline{k}\]
\[= -20\underline{i} + 110\underline{j} + 50\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\) ka minor \((-3)(30) - (7)(-10) = -90 + 70 = -20\). \(\underline{j}\) ka minor \((1)(30) - (7)(20) = 30 - 140 = -110\), minus sign ke saath \(+110\). \(\underline{k}\) ka minor \((1)(-10) - (-3)(20) = -10 + 60 = 50\). Row 2 mein \(\underline{r}\), row 3 mein \(\underline{F}\): tarteeb \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\).

Miqdaar aur tasdeeq
\[|\underline{\tau}| = \sqrt{400 + 12100 + 2500}\]
\[= \sqrt{15000} = 50\sqrt{6} \approx 122.5 \text{ Nm}\]
\[\underline{\tau} \cdot \underline{r} = -20 - 330 + 350 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[\underline{\tau} \cdot \underline{F} = -400 - 1100 + 1500 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(15000 = 2500 \times 6\), is liye \(50\sqrt{6}\). Cross product dono vectors ke perpendicular hota hai, aur dono dot products 0 aaye, to torque sahi hai. Unit Newton \(\times\) meter = Nm.
